thesis: IDXX is a high-quality, profitable name (net income +15.5% YoY against revenue +9.9%) consolidating a held 11/2 post-earnings gap on light volume (vol_ratio 0.78) with strong rs_63 0.35, in healthcare, one of only three sectors above the 50-day. The setup is valid, but at the last price of 676.21 reward/risk to the 713.74 target over the 647 stop is only 1.28, below the 1.5 floor. The card's 2.2 R/R assumes a 668 midpoint fill. In a risk-off tape (regime confidence 0.95, VIX 31.34 at the 0.991 percentile), a 1-ATR stop is exposed to gap-down risk, and valuation is unknown. Stop and target are unchanged from the technical card. The entry zone is narrowed from [660, 676] to [660, 668] because R/R stays at or above 1.5 only below about 673.7. A fill at or below 668 that holds above SMA20 (658.69) would justify reconsidering Overweight at the pre-close review.
invalidation: A daily close below 647 (under the 650.00 Nov 6 low and the post-earnings gap base) invalidates the setup.
